prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance, with when, what it was for and the amount. Refunds read "Refund: <action>". I did not load the page in a browser, so the layout is unchecked. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes and eslint reports no new warnings on the page. All action names, labels and states are in both `en.json` and `ko.json` with the same keys. Amounts are red for charges and green for credits. The table reloads when the balance changes, and it shows loading, empty and error states. No frontend test was added.

+        Gives back the credits charged by deduct_credits for an AI action that failed.

diff --git a/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c47aaed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_generation_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_generation_keeps_charge(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before - 15
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_character_sheet_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "d", "style": "s"},
+    )
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "ink wash"})
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+SYNC_CALLS = [
+    ("post", "/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", {"title": "t", "description": "d"}),
+    ("post", "/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", {"description": "d"}),
+    ("post", "/api/v1/scenes/structure", {"script": "a door opens"}),
+    ("post", "/api/v1/scenes/render", {"prompt": "a door"}),
+    ("post", "/api/v1/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": "data:image/png;base64,AAAA", "instruction": "x"}),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method,url,body", SYNC_CALLS)
+def test_failed_sync_ai_call_refunds_credits(client, method, url, body):
+    h = signup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = getattr(client, method)(url, headers=h, json=body)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert r.status_code >= 400
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_character_ai_calls_refund_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/characters/augment", {"name": "M", "tags": [], "mood": [], "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/analyze", {"project_id": pid, "name": "M"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggest", {"project_id": pid, "type": "name"}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/augment", {"name": "M", "tags": [], "mood": "m", "style": "s"}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", None),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/create", {"project_id": pid, "title": "t", "summary": "s"}),
+    ]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    for url, body in calls:
+        try:
+            r = client.post(url, headers=h, json=body) if body is not None else client.post(url, headers=h)
+            assert r.status_code >= 400, (url, r.status_code, r.text)
+        except RuntimeError:
+            pass  # endpoint let the AI error escape; the credits must still come back
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_refund_is_recorded_as_a_transaction(client):
+    from sqlmodel import Session, select
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", headers=h, json={"description": "d"})
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        amounts = sorted(t.amount for t in s.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.action_type.in_(["recommend_style", "refund_recommend_style"]))))
+    assert amounts == [-1, 1]
+
+
+def _ws_id(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = _ws_id(client, h)
+    client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h)  # triggers daily refill
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", headers=h, json={"description": "d"})
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("refund_recommend_style", 1),
+        ("recommend_style", -1),
+        ("daily_refill", 50),
+    ]
+    assert all(i["created_at"] for i in items)
+
+
+def test_credit_history_is_404_for_non_members(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    ws = _ws_id(client, h)
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{missing}/credits/history", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history").status_code == 401
